target_customer: Consumers in Korea and Japan first, paying a premium subscription for a personal AI agent
problem: Daily life administration such as bookings, phone calls and errands eats time; Pickle gives each user an agent that executes these tasks and coordinates with friends' agents.
business_model: Consumer subscription (premium tier reported at $8.99 per month)
product_category: Consumer personal AI agent app (began as real-time AI avatar for video calls)

founders.name: Daniel Park
education: Dropped out of medical school (per YC page)
previous_startups: Built an e-commerce business while in medical school (per YC page); a search snippet names it Kumefood, unverified

founders.name: Sanio Jung
education: Former medical doctor, self-taught engineer (per YC page)

founders.name: Emmett Kim
previous_startups: Consumer app that reached #1 in App Store Social category (per YC page)

technical_complexity.rationale: The avatar product needed real-time face and voice cloning with a deepfake misuse module, and the later agent needs reliable tool execution, local payments and messaging integrations, hard but built on available models.

defensibility.rationale: Agent to agent network effects are claimed but unproven; model access and integrations with Kakao and LINE are replicable and the team is six people.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Avatar rivals were found in vendor comparisons; no source shows an incumbent copying Pickle's agent product.

market_need_then: Real-time AI avatars for video calls were an active category in 2024 and 2025; the Korean consumer agent market was open as of the 2026 pivot. Company reports 70 percent D1 retention, unverified.

branding.domain_note: pickle.com is the company domain per YC page; acquisition history not found

identity.visual_style: Playful consumer tone; app page title in Korean

branding.community_and_virality: Search coverage mixes several unrelated Pickle companies, and an AR glasses product also called Pickle 1 went viral then drew fake claims; no source on the brand of this company itself.

brand_strength.rationale: Name is generic and shared with other companies, and no source shows brand driven growth.

pivots.from: AI Self, a real-time avatar for video meetings launched October 2024
pivots.to: Personal AI agent app for tasks and agent to agent coordination
pivots.why: Korean iOS closed beta began October 14, 2026 per one profile; the reason is not stated

outcome_analysis: Pickle is active, joined YC W25, raised a reported 6 billion KRW seed in June 2025 and has pivoted from a video call avatar to a consumer personal agent app, reaching a reported top free app ranking in Korea in late 2026. It is too early to call the outcome, and later rounds beyond the seed were not found.
notes: Identification: YC page lists Daniel Park, Korean coverage names CEO Park Chaekeun and Daniel Park (Park Chae-geun) per foxcg, treated as the same company. YC page also mentions Sam Yu (CTO) and Chris Kang; a Korean profile lists them as YC founders but the YC page text does not, so they are not listed. Aggregators list a $12M Series A in March 2025 that no press supports; ignored. Seed dollar figure varies by outlet ($4M to $4.4M). A search snippet said a Pickle AR glasses product refunded preorders; not verified to be this company. Competitor search returned only undated vendor comparisons, so list is empty. wowtale fetch returned 403.
